summary: All five round-1 gaps are closed and the new tests are load-bearing. (1) data:image/... URL → icon/label fallback with explicit DOM-absent assertion. (2) Positive caption assertion: IMAGE + http(s) url + caption → [data-test=funnel-canvas-preview-caption] renders exact text. (3) ALBUM http(s): thumb src asserted to equal album0.png (the FIRST item, not album1.png); caption asserted to 'Album caption'. ALBUM non-http items[0] (tg-file-id-opaque) → no thumb img, fallback span present, opaque id absent from DOM. (4) buildEdges MESSAGE-guard: DELAY + timeoutTargetStepId → zero timeout edges (litmus: deleting the stepType === 'MESSAGE' guard makes the edge appear, test fails); MESSAGE + timeoutTargetStepId → timeout edge with correct source/target (litmus: removing emit path makes findEdge throw). (5) Dead key 'funnels.canvas.preview.imageUnavailable' removed from REQUIRED_KEYS list and from both locale files; remaining preview keys still enforced. No existing tests removed or weakened.
